verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only built-in, lifecycle-bound automation: Stripe can automatically send reminders or retry payment when an invoice is overdue or fails (docs-13, docs-28), and the API can automate collection (docs-2). Nothing shows users defining their own recurring schedules for jobs, workflows, or invoices. Missing for 10: user-defined recurring schedules for invoices or workflows, cron-like or scheduled job configuration, documentation of schedule management via API/CLI/MCP, and independent corroboration.
